summary: The PR addresses the issue by checking for non-integer powers in the conversion matrix and returning the original expression if found. This prevents incorrect conversions but may not cover all edge cases.

issues.description: The fix checks for non-integer powers but does not address other potential issues with unit compatibility or conversion logic. There might be other edge cases not covered.
